_comment: EvalLens quality-gate thresholds. DETERMINISTIC thresholds were set from the measured baseline run evallens/runs/20261110T142928Z.json (67 questions, extractive/offline mode, commit b2ab7dd): faithfulness 1.000, answer_relevancy 0.613, context_precision 0.953, context_recall 0.997, refusal_accuracy 0.167. Each threshold sits ~0.05 below its baseline aggregate, so a real regression fails the gate while ordinary run-to-run noise passes. JUDGE thresholds were tightened 2026-11-10 from the two measured Groq-judge runs — NO single run was fully clean, so each threshold comes from the run where that metric was cleanly measured: faithfulness 0.95 from Run 4 (20261110T154611Z.json, measured 1.000 after the full-width-citation fix; Run 3's 0.873 was deflated by the citation-splitting bug, now fixed); answer_relevancy 0.74 from Run 3 (20261110T145619Z.json, measured 0.792 with all-LLM answers; Run 4's 0.753 was dragged down by 15 extractive Kaveri answers after Groq throttling); context_precision 0.90 and context_recall 0.95 from both runs (0.953 / 0.997 in each — these metrics use ground truth, not the judge, so they are stable across runs); refusal_accuracy 0.80 from Run 3 (measured 1.000, 6/6 refused with all-LLM answers; Run 4's 0.667 was 4/6 because the 2 unanswerable Kaveri questions got extractive answers that never refuse). Refusal is 6 questions, so 0.80 allows one miss (5/6) — a 0.95 bar would demand 6/6 and fail the gate on any throttled run, which is an infrastructure flake, not a quality regression. A fully clean single judge run (all-LLM answers + fixed citations) has not happened yet — Groq's free tier throttled hard on both attempts (Run 4 took 47 min, with 30s Retry-After waits). Re-run with a longer --pace when the rate limit resets to confirm all five thresholds in one run. NOTE on refusal_accuracy (deterministic): 0.167 is a KNOWN WEAKNESS of the extractive fallback, not a target — without an LLM, Knowlix returns the most relevant passage for unanswerable questions instead of refusing (only the adversarial password question refused, because the sanitizer strips the injected sentence). The judge-mode threshold of 0.80 is the real target for production behaviour; the deterministic 0.15 only guards against getting worse than the known-bad baseline.
